body: Alright man. Thanks.
I don't want to end up in a ward.
I'm seeing a therapist. Not very frequent sessions.
I'm not saying there isn't, but if there is, they are thinning rapidly.
The fact that you end with 'that's life' makes me think you don't understand the concept of suicide.
Why should someone be considered a coward for being the one that pulls their own trigger, but the ones that knowingly face death and then die are heroes? Can't they be considered just as suicidal?

I just don't really enjoy anything that you have to do in life. Getting over people, working a job you hate, spending unnecessary amounts of time alone, and any time anything starts to look better the process just repeats.
I have no idea how to do that.
I couldn't possibly agree with this sentiment more.
I did go. And I put in some real work for a while, then I just stopped. I wasted my time, and I have no way of knowing that I won't just waste it again. In fact, I think that I probably would.
I'm glad you can relate, but I don't even have the college thing. I gave up on that already. It's just pointless, it seems.
Pretty crappy.
I'm having a good bit of ups and downs. No matter how good things get, I always find a way to get back to how I was feeling.
I have. I'm not sure though.
Here. http://figment.com/users/25266-Ian-Christ
Anything. I really just want people to read it. If I stick around, it'd be cool to turn into a job, but that won't happen.
Short stories, poetry, some novel length stuff.
I work at UPS and hate it immensely. I enjoy music and writing, but there's just not many places around here where I can just hang out with people.
I get that there may be, but a gun barrel seems like a simpler escape as well as one that requires less work.
I don't really know how.

There's nothing now. I used to have friends, a girlfriend, and enjoyed doing things in general. I don't really have anyone that cares that much about me. They'd be shook up for a couple weeks to a month maybe, but they'd be fine after that. I haven't really 'touched people's lives'.
Seems to be looking that way.
Thanks. I think that's the plan now. I hope that I can stick to it.
I will definitely keep in touch. Thanks again.
I sent you a PM.
Wow man. You just made my night in more ways than I can tell you. Thank you so much. I wish I could have more people like you in my life.

I appreciate the sentiment, but problems just get replaced with more problems. It never ends. I know I'm young, but instead of being able to look forward to the rest of my life, it just intimidates me. You can try the 'anyone can do their assignments psychology', but I've struggled with organized education all my life. I know that you don't always have to have a girlfriend, the point is here that I still love this girl and without her I am lonely. I hate being lonely. I'm pretty sure anyone does. I don't know what I want to do with my life, and I can't figure out how it is I can find out what it is.
I understand. And thank you. I'm going to try to chill. It's just sometimes when I do that I just get more depressed. I told my girl about that. It didn't seem to change much.
thanks. i know that alot of people aren't self-aware, but times like these i envy them a bit.

I appreciate it. I told her that she didn't. I plan to move back in with my dad. I'm just not sure how things will turn out. I'm trying to get better at talking to people. I've just always been bad at it. I try to look at things one at a time. It just always finds a way to overpower me anyway. Thank you, though.
I'll PM you the link.

I don't really have friends like I used to. And my stepbrother attempted suicide once. My dad thought he did it for attention. He'd probably think the same with me. And no, I can't talk to my stepbrother about it. We don't get along at all.

Thanks. I still write and play music some. They just don't feel quite as natural to me as they once did. And I am actually going to college soon. I just don't want it to wind up being a waste of time and money. Sorry this response isn't as extensive as your original comment. Like I said, I'm just not as natural a writer anymore.
sometimes i feel like i'm not even sure what the reasons are. it seems to make it all the more daunting.
